title: Aircraft Ground Handling Risk Assessment
description: Free Aircraft Ground Handling Risk Assessment template for aviation you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers operational information, risk tolerance and action requirements, detailed control measures and mitigations.

Risk Tolerance And Action Requirements

RISK LEVELACTION REQUIRED
EXTREME (15-25) HIGH (8-14) MEDIUM (4-7) LOW (1-3)IMMEDIATE ACTION: Operation must NOT proceed. Immediate mitigation required. URGENT ACTION: Senior management attention required. Action plan within 24 hours. PLANNED ACTION: Specific monitoring or procedures required. Action plan within 1 week. MONITOR: Acceptable, but continue monitoring for changes.

Detailed Control Measures And Mitigations

EXISTING CONTROLS:

Marshalling procedures (IATA AHM 411) Wing walkers mandatory

Headset communication protocols Clearance procedures

Daily FOD walks Tool control program

GSE speed limiters (max 10 km/h) Reverse alarms on all vehicles

Proximity sensors on high-value equipment Training program (initial & recurrent)

Designated vehicle routes Stop signs at intersections

Ramp lighting standards (ICAO Annex 14) Safety briefings before each shift

ADDITIONAL CONTROLS REQUIRED:
